completed: MPI-387 A Linux half CLOSED. tar.gz 502967733 bytes byte-exact, ONE top-level folder, 6384 files on disk (+1 over the manifest's 6383 - Windows showed the same +1, 6418 recorded vs 6419 actual, so it is the manifest not counting itself). uv/uv and the Electron binary both kept their exec bits. app/ + resources/ + uv/ at top level is the CORRECT Linux layout (build-portable.mjs:39-65 - resources/app is win32-only).

MPI-406 FOUND AND FIXED. A --cpu engine install resolved the entire CUDA 13 stack. Proven from the engine's own requirements.compiled: torch==2.13.0 with NO +cpu tag, triton==3.7.1, and 14 nvidia-* wheels. Root cause: --fast-deps routes through comfy-cli's DependencyCompiler which IGNORES the vendor flag - the identical fall-through was already exempted for --m-series at engine.js:370-372, but --cpu kept --fast-deps. Fixed by gating --fast-deps on --nvidia so --cpu and --amd both take the standard vendor-aware install.

MPI-407 FOUND AND FIXED. main.js:789-795 gives up waiting for the server after a hardcoded 5000ms and creates the window anyway; the server bound 11.6s after launch, so loadURL was refused with ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED and NOTHING retried it - permanently black window. No user-accessible recovery, because Menu.setApplicationMenu(null) at main.js:379 leaves Ctrl+R unbound. Fixed with a did-fail-load handler retrying the main-frame load every 500ms (cap 60, skips ERR_ABORTED). The 5000ms constant was deliberately left alone - raising it is the symptom patch.

MPI-408 FOUND AND FIXED. uv venv exits 2 with 'A virtual environment already exists at: comfy-venv' whenever the target exists - a COMPLETE venv, not just a broken one. So the first attempt past step 1 poisons every later one and the Installation Failed dialog's Retry button can NEVER succeed on Linux/macOS, whatever originally failed. Root cause is an asymmetry inside _provisionUvEngine: step 0b (engine.js:341-347) already clears a stale ComfyUI workspace, but its sibling comfy-venv had no guard. Fixed with --clear.

All three fixes committed (f2e966b1, 86deac5b), changelogged with three user-facing entries, release:approve re-run BOTH times, release:check passing, pushed to origin/master (HEAD 892f69a6 plus the MPI-409 kanban commit).

key_decisions: MPI-198's plan.md:24 precondition is STRICTER THAN REALITY and should not be followed literally. It asks for a hand-installed sub-subfoldered LoRA, but the shipped templates already bake backslashed subfolder values everywhere: krea2_t2i_*.json:1197 'krea-2\extra\...', :1296-1317 lora_1..lora_5 'krea-2\style\...', ltx_i2v*.json:1222 three levels deep, klein_t2i.json:542, wan5b_t2v.json:120. Any default Krea 2 t2i on the Linux local engine reproduces it.

SDXL and the masking graph CANNOT prove MPI-198. Every path value in t2i_sdxl_realistic.json is flat ('SDXL_Realistic.safetensors', lora_name 'None'), and img_auto_mask.json's three values are flat or forward-slash-only. Do not waste a download on either expecting a result.

MPI-198 does NOT need a completed generation. value_not_in_list is enum-membership, validated at /prompt BEFORE any weight is read, so a 200 + prompt_id is the proof. This is why MPI-198 is closable on a GPU-less box and MPI-249 is not.

The Windows validation from the previous session STILL HOLDS against the new build and does not need redoing. Only main.js, routes/engine.js and releaseNotes.js changed: the Electron binary is byte-identical so the SAC/MOTW result stands, file counts are unchanged so MPI-387 A stands, update-from-zip.bat is untouched so the transition test stands, and Windows never reaches _provisionUvEngine. A two-minute launch smoke on the new Windows extract is worth doing as insurance, not the full sweep.

The three fixes were landed on 1.3.0 itself rather than deferred to 1.3.1, at the user's explicit call, because nothing is published yet. Version stays 1.3.0 - there is no released 1.3.0 to collide with.
